text:
### 14.3 Governing Law  
These terms are governed by **English Law**. Courts of England & Wales have jurisdiction.

raw_entities.description: Contractual provision establishing that the product terms and conditions are governed by English Law, with exclusive jurisdiction vested in the Courts of England & Wales.
